name: TAAMEER Agents Studio — Reel Reference Library
notes: 15 Marketing-selected TikTok references. Three have approved specific filming classifications; 12 newly added references have verified creator/video IDs and generic source tags pending visual analysis. All use TikTok official embeds.

references.title: Outdoor Property Walkthrough
references.description: A real estate presenter introduces a property from an outdoor balcony and shows the surroundings. A reference for on-location property storytelling.
references.creator: @hossam_allam__
references.creative_notes: Adapt the location walk-through approach with original commentary, an approved property view, and a genuine buyer insight. No unsupported price or view claims.

references.title: Showroom Model Walkthrough
references.description: A handheld walkthrough of a real estate display model and showroom. A reference for simple, direct-to-camera-free project explanations.
references.creator: @dxb1realestate
references.creative_notes: Film a showroom model with a smartphone, explain verified details and helpful buyer questions; avoid copying third-party offers or prices.

references.title: Real Estate Screen Demo
references.description: A short indoor demonstration of property-related information on a phone screen. A reference for educational screen-led content.
references.creator: @walid_alzarooni
references.creative_notes: Explain a useful property process with original narration. Show only publicly shareable screens; avoid personal data and unapproved legal assurances.
